title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
AN452
Doing Fieldwork
1.0 Credit
- Winter
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Students
develop and carry out their own ethnographic research projects under the supervision of the course director, and engage in project management and project communication. Using a combination of skills acquired in
AN300
- Ethnographic Methods and/or other qualitative methodology courses, students write a proposal, develop analytical questions and undertake participant-observation in a fieldwork project that can be based on a project previously
developed in
AN450
 Current Topics in Anthropology. The
end product documents the research and addresses issues
raised by it.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AN300
,
AN450
and one of the following:
AN100
, AN110, AN120 (or the former AN101). An equivalent methods course in another program may count as
AN300
after consultation with the undergraduate advisor.
Exclusions
AN400
